name: context-keeper
description: Local, zero-dependency project memory for AI assistants: decisions, constraints, and workflows with the rationale behind them.
long_description: Context Keeper is a local MCP server that gives AI coding assistants persistent project memory — the decisions, constraints, and workflows of a project and the reasoning behind them — so a new session doesn't start from zero or confidently redo what you already ruled out. Structured, rationale-first memory with schema-enforced "why," origin-based trust, hybrid retrieval (full-text + optional local semantic) with honest abstention, a knowledge lifecycle (supersede, contradiction detection, dedup-and-merge, decay, explicit forget), and a structured field query alongside relevance search. Everything is stored as readable JSON in a folder you choose. Zero dependencies by default; nothing leaves your machine.

context_directory.title: Storage directory
context_directory.description: Folder where Context Keeper keeps your project memory. A .context/ subfolder of readable JSON is created here on first write. Everything stays local — nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: record_entry
tools.description: Unified write tool: record a decision, constraint, or pipeline, with structured rationale validated server-side.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Relevance-ranked retrieval by query/tags/scope, within a token budget, with honest abstention.

tools.name: query_entries
tools.description: Deterministic structured-field filtering (status, origin, tags, scope, hardness, supersession, dates).

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.description: Concise overview of active decisions, pipelines, and constraints.

tools.name: update_entry
tools.description: Update an existing entry by ID; refreshes verified_at.

tools.name: deprecate_entry
tools.description: Retire an entry; optionally merge a duplicate into a surviving entry.

tools.name: prune_stale
tools.description: Find entries not verified recently, for review.

tools.name: get_compaction_report
tools.description: Report whether the last context compaction lost or modified entries.

tools.name: verify_quality
tools.description: Scan entries for thin rationale, missing tags, and isolated arcs.

tools.name: export_markdown
tools.description: Regenerate DECISIONS.md as a read-only projection of the decisions store.

tools.name: reload_constraints
tools.description: Re-surface the constraints-only block on demand mid-session.

tools.name: export_snapshot
tools.description: Write the whole store to a committable .context-keeper/memory.json.gz snapshot for sharing project memory with a team.

tools.name: import_snapshot
tools.description: Import the committed snapshot into the working store; non-destructive, skips a store that already has entries.

tools.name: mirror
tools.description: Sync entries with the optional remote store: op='pull' merges remote into local, op='backfill' upserts local to remote.
